Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

drift off to sleep verb

also drop off, drop off to sleep, fall asleep

modern

Traupman 306

in somnum dēlābī

Other words

  • obdormīscō, obdormīscere — fall asleep, drop off

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. Tusc. 1.117: in mediīs vītae labōribus obdormīscere (Lewis & Short); Traupman 307

Examples

  • Theodōrus, statim in somnum dēlāpsus, per tōtum iter dormīvit

    Theo dropped off at once and slept the whole wayLibellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

See also sleep, doze, nod off.

SourcesLewis & Short: obdormisco
